title: Lanac snabdijevanja modela
summary: Zašto je pickle izvršavanje koda, prelazak na safetensors, skeniranje modela i njegova ograničenja, pinovanje, potpisivanje (OpenSSF Model Signing, cosign) i AI-BOM u CycloneDX-u.
summary_en: Why pickle means code execution, moving to safetensors, model scanning and its limits, pinning, signing (OpenSSF Model Signing, cosign) and an AI-BOM in CycloneDX.
